page_title: HOF 3-1 AUG | Hoffenheim v Augsburg 07/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Florian Exner has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Hoffenheim take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

90+3' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Hoffenheim.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' 3 - 1 Goal! Pavel Kaderabek puts a cross into the box and finds Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the roof of the net. He makes it 3:1.
88' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to substitute Maximilian Beier and he is replaced by Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim).
88' Florian Exner shows the yellow card to Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) for a heavy challenge.
87' Substitution. Finn Ole Becker (Hoffenheim) has come on for Grischa Promel.
85' The attendance for today's match is 28881.
84' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) finds his way to a rebound on the edge of the box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but the keeper dives and denies him.
84' Hoffenheim will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
84' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Hoffenheim can continue in their attacking effort.
84' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

83' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The referee signals a corner kick to Hoffenheim.
81' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Augsburg.

81' Pep Biel (Augsburg) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear. The ball is out of play. Augsburg will have a chance to score from a corner.

80' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The linesman makes the right call and Augsburg will have a corner.
80' Flag goes up against Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
79' Hoffenheim can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
78' Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Corner kick. Hoffenheim will have an opportunity.
75' The game has come to an end for Arne Maier. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Pep Biel (Augsburg).
75' Substitution. Mert Komur (Augsburg) in, Arne Engels out.
75' Today's match ends for Ruben Vargas who will be replaced by Dion Beljo (Augsburg).
75' That's the end of the game for Andrej Kramaric, who is replaced by Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim).
75' Pellegrino Matarazzo prepares a substitution. David Jurasek is replaced by Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim).
74' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
67' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 10:10.
64' Jess Thorup has decided to make a change. Patric Pfeiffer (Augsburg) replaces Maximilian Bauer.
64' The substitution has been made. John Anthony Brooks (Hoffenheim) has replaced Ozan Kabak.
63' Augsburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
63' Decent spell from Augsburg here and they keep the pressure on until one of the defending players steps in. Now Augsburg have a corner.
61' 2 - 1 Goal! Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Phillip Tietz, then sends the ball into the bottom left corner. 2:1.
59' The ball is cleared after Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.

57' What a chance that is! Arne Maier (Augsburg) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass on the edge of the box and fires towards the net. Unfortunately for him, he only hits the left post!
55' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
54' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
53' A dangerous looking corner kick from Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) is cleared to safety by the defence. Hoffenheim force their opponents to concede a corner.

53' Hoffenheim are showing great team-chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly but finally one of the defending players makes an interception. The ball goes behind for a corner. Hoffenheim will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
51' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Florian Exner ignores the protests.
48' Augsburg quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

47' Arne Engels (Augsburg) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Oliver Baumann makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! The referee points to the corner flag and Augsburg will take a corner.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) sends it out of play.
45+1' Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee blows his whistle, Hoffenheim are awarded a corner kick.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) steps up to send the ball in.

45' Hoffenheim play a few nice passes from player to player, but their possession doesn't last long as an opposition player intercepts a pass. Hoffenheim force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
42' Maximilian Bauer (Augsburg) is unlucky with a low drive from the edge of the box. A decent save by Oliver Baumann stops the ball from hitting the middle of the net.
41' David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Florian Exner pulls out a yellow card.
41' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Arne Engels (Augsburg).
38' The foul by Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Florian Exner.
38' Arne Engels (Augsburg) serves up a nice cross, but Oliver Baumann punches the ball away.
37' Augsburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
36' A cross into the box from Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) is cleared. Augsburg win a corner.
36' Augsburg are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.

35' The ball rebounds out to David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
34' The resulting corner from Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

34' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Hoffenheim will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
32' David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
32' Arne Maier (Augsburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
31' It's a throw-in for Augsburg.
30' 5:0 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
29' Good defending. Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) tries to find Wout Weghorst inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
28' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) attempts to find Ermedin Demirovic, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
25' Augsburg hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.

23' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) misses a good chance to score. A perfect cross into the box finds Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) who rises for a header, but he sends the ball well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.

20' 2 - 0 Goal! Great link up play between Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) and Wout Weghorst gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the bottom right corner. 2:0.
19' Felix Uduokhai (Augsburg) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
17' 1 - 0 Goal! Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) finishes from close range with an easy finish and he makes it 1:0. He was ably assisted there by Pavel Kaderabek.
16' Oliver Baumann leaps to intercept the corner kick from Arne Maier (Augsburg).
15' Augsburg are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear. Augsburg get a corner.
12' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Tim Breithaupt.
9' Florian Exner blows his whistle and signals a foul after Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) brought his opponent down.
7' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) takes the corner which is cleared.
7' Hoffenheim take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. It will be a corner kick for Hoffenheim.

7' Hoffenheim keep the ball well and push forward with purpose, but here comes an interception from the opposition. Hoffenheim have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
5' Hoffenheim keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
4' Referee Florian Exner sees the trip by Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
1' The first half has just begun.
Florian Exner will officiate today.
